name: Shawl
description: A worn cloth shawl pulled over the head. Offers little protection but keeps out the chill.

name: Leather Cap
description: A simple cap of boiled leather. Better than nothing.

name: Iron Helm
description: A sturdy iron helmet that covers the skull and cheeks.

name: Ogre Helm
description: A massive, terrifying helmet forged from dark iron and reinforced with ogre tusks. It exudes a primal aura of strength.

name: Amethyst Wardancer Helm
description: A lightweight elven helm forged from shimmering silver and inlaid with glowing amethyst. It enhances the wearer's agility and focus.

name: Celestial Vindicator Helm
description: A magnificent helm forged from glowing white metal and polished silver. It radiates a warm, holy light, protecting the wearer's mind with divine yellow energy.

name: Ironpeak Dwarf Helm
description: A powerful dwarf warrior helmet forged from thick iron and bronze. It bears the mark of the Ironpeak clan.

name: Sylvan Elderwood Hood
description: A mystical hood woven from ancient sylvan leaves and strong magical threads.

name: Mountain Stalker Hood
description: A rugged leather hood lined with thick fur, perfect for the cold peaks.

name: Aethelgard Archmage Hood
description: A silk hood shimmering with arcane energy, focusing the wearer's mind.

name: Storm-Reaver Helmet
description: A savage-looking helmet forged from jagged iron and dragon-bone.

name: Seraphic Grace Cowl
description: A pure white cowl that radiates a soft, holy light.

name: Seers Shawl
description: A mystical shawl woven from ancient sylvan leaves and strong magical threads.

name: Trickster's Hood
description: A cunning hood worn by dungeon rogues. Its subtle enchantments sharpen the wearer's eye for hidden mechanisms.

name: Crest of the Caw
description: An ornate headpiece crafted from dark obsidian and shimmering crow feathers. It focuses the wearer's mind with the mystical echo of the Crow Wizard.
